items.name: Moss Mother
items.how: The first boss, in the upper part of the Ruined Chapel. Cut the two vines blocking the entrance to reach her. Beating her opens the way up out of Moss Grotto.

items.name: Hunter Crest
items.how: The starting Crest, owned from the beginning.
items.effect: The starting Crest: a plain forward slash and a diagonal down-attack.

items.name: Silk Spear
items.how: A Silk Skill. Reach Mosshome from The Marrow by heading left past Shakra, the map seller. Climb to its upper part and interact with the idol there to learn it.

items.name: Choral Commandment
items.how: A relic on a ledge on the east side of the shaft above Bone Bottom, behind a breakable wall. Reach it from the west edge of Mosshome.

items.name: Simple Key
items.how: Buy it from Pebb, the merchant in the middle of Bone Bottom, for 500 Rosaries; he sells only one. It opens locked gates, such as the one to Flintslate.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Moss Grotto
items.how: Behind a breakable wall in the mossy rooms above Bone Bottom: from the Mosshome lift go right and break the weak wall in the left corner of the next room.

items.name: Druid's Eye
items.how: The Moss Druid's wish, Berry Picking: gather Mossberries from the mossy lowlands and bring them back.
items.effect: Gives Silk when Hornet is hit.

items.name: Shard Pendant
items.how: In a small room west of the tall central chamber.
items.effect: More Shell Shards from foes.

items.name: Compass
items.how: Sold by Shakra the map seller for 70 Rosaries.

items.name: Quill
items.how: Sold by Shakra the map seller for 50 Rosaries. It draws the rooms you visit onto the maps you bought.

items.name: Mosslands Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra, whom you first meet in The Marrow, for 40 Rosaries. It is also called the Bone Bottom Map.

items.name: The Marrow Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra for 50 Rosaries.

items.name: Bench Pins
items.how: A map pin that marks benches. Sold by Shakra for 60 Rosaries.

items.name: Shell Marker
items.how: A map marker you can place yourself. Sold by Shakra for 40 Rosaries.

items.name: Bell Beast
items.how: Trapped in silk at the Bellway. Cut it free with Silk Spear and beat it; the Bellway then works for travel.

items.name: Silk Heart, Bell Beast
items.how: After the win, touch the silk the Bell Beast leaves behind and climb the short challenge of crumbling platforms it opens; the Silk Heart is at the top.

items.name: Straight Pin
items.how: In Grindle's prison cell, in the tall room at the far right near the way to Hunter's March. Free him to reach it.
items.effect: A light pin you throw.

items.name: Tool Pouch upgrade, Loddle
items.how: Pass Loddle's aiming challenge with the Straight Pin.

items.name: Magnetite Brooch
items.how: Sold in the Bone Bottom shop for 120 Rosaries.

items.name: Memory Locket, Volatile Flintbeetles
items.how: The reward for the Volatile Flintbeetles wish, handed in at the Bone Bottom Wishwall. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Swift Step
items.how: Climb to the top of the Deep Docks and bind the Weaver effigy there. A dash.

items.name: Deep Docks Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra for 50 Rosaries.

items.name: Crafting Kit, Forge Daughter
items.how: Sold by the Forge Daughter for 180 Rosaries.

items.name: Magma Bell
items.how: Sold by the Forge Daughter for 110 Rosaries and a Craftmetal.
items.effect: Less damage from fire and lava.

items.name: Sting Shard
items.how: Sold by the Forge Daughter for 140 Rosaries and a Craftmetal.
items.effect: A trap that hangs in the air.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Deep Docks
items.how: At the end of a platforming challenge near the Forge Daughter.

items.name: Memory Locket, Deep Docks
items.how: At the very bottom of the Deep Docks, left of the big chamber with the diving bell. Break a wall on a ledge and follow the hidden way down to a corpse.

items.name: Lace
items.how: Dash in mid-air to reach the lever near Shakra's room; it opens Lace's arena. Beating her opens the way to Far Fields.

items.name: Mask Shard, Bone Bottom shop
items.how: Sold in the Bone Bottom shop for 300 Rosaries.

items.name: Warding Bell
items.how: At the bottom of the central Far Fields room.
items.effect: A one-hit shield while Hornet binds.

items.name: Far Fields Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra, who waits in a cave in the southwest of Far Fields, for 50 Rosaries.

items.name: Drifter's Cloak
items.how: The Seamstress's wish, Flexile Spines: collect Spine Cores from Hokers and bring them to her. The cloak lets you glide on air currents.

items.name: Weaver Effigy
items.how: A relic in a small room high above Bone Bottom. From the platforms on the east side, above the lever, dash-jump and glide to it.

items.name: Mask Shard, Far Fields
items.how: Above the Seamstress's home; glide up to it.

items.name: Bone Scroll
items.how: A relic east of the Seamstress's home. Ride the tall wind current up, then hit the lava bulb to uncover a corpse that holds it.

items.name: Flintslate
items.how: Behind a locked gate in Deep Docks, on the way towards Far Fields. The gate needs a Simple Key from a merchant.
items.effect: Sets the Needle alight for a few seconds, for more damage and a chance to burn.

items.name: Fourth Chorus
items.how: Blocks the way up once you have the cloak. Beating it opens the air vents up to Pilgrim's Rest and Greymoor.

items.name: Weighted Belt
items.how: Sold at Pilgrim's Rest for 160 Rosaries.
items.effect: Less knockback, both taken and from Hornet's own hits.

items.name: Tool Pouch upgrade, Pilgrim's Rest
items.how: Sold at Pilgrim's Rest for 220 Rosaries.

items.name: Memory Locket, Pilgrim's Rest
items.how: Sold by Mort in Pilgrim's Rest for 150 Rosaries. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Hunter's March Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra.

items.name: Curveclaw
items.how: Sold by Mottled Skarr for 140 Rosaries.

items.name: Fractured Mask
items.how: Sold by Mottled Skarr for 260 Rosaries.
items.effect: Survives one fatal hit, then breaks; a bench mends it.

items.name: Memory Locket, Hunter's March
items.how: On a corpse just before the Chapel of the Beast. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Savage Beastfly
items.how: In the Chapel of the Beast at the east end of the March, after a short climb.

items.name: Memory Locket, Hunter's March hidden room
items.how: In a hidden room past the chapel boss.

items.name: Beast Crest
items.how: Bind the great husk in the chapel after the fight.
items.effect: Savage strikes. Its Bind sends Hornet into a fury that heals through hits instead of the normal heal.

items.name: Thread Storm
items.how: Win the bird fights in the building at Craw Lake, pull the lever so balloons appear, then pogo up them to the Weaver statue at the top right of Greymoor.

items.name: Greymoor Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra for 70 Rosaries.

items.name: Reaper Crest
items.how: In the arena of the Chapel of the Reaper.
items.effect: Bigger, slower swings with a wide down-attack. After a Bind, hits make Silk pieces that refill a little Silk when picked up.

items.name: Threefold Pin
items.how: In a hidden room above the Craw House; set the bouncing platforms moving to reach it.
items.effect: Throws three pins at once in a spread.

items.name: Memory Locket, Halfway Home
items.how: In a hidden room near Creige at Halfway Home. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Bone Scroll
items.how: A relic east of Halfway Home. Swim along a hidden path, then drop down to a corpse.

items.name: Flea Brew
items.how: Fleamaster Mooshka's wish, The Lost Fleas: once five fleas have joined the Flea Caravan, it moves on and she gives you this.
items.effect: Faster attacks and movement for about ten seconds.

items.name: Moorwing
items.how: Greymoor's last boss, at its far left. Beating it opens the way to Bellhart.

items.name: Memory Locket, Moorwing
items.how: Past the fan to the right of the Moorwing arena. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Mask Shard, Shellwood
items.how: Behind a breakable wall, past a trap of flowers.

items.name: Shellwood Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra.

items.name: Longpin
items.how: Behind the wasp nest in Shellwood.
items.effect: A heavy pin that pierces shells.

items.name: Pollip Pouch
items.how: Greyroot's wish, Rite of the Pollip: gather Pollip Hearts from the purple flowers of Shellwood.
items.effect: Adds venom to red Tools.

items.name: Sister Splinter
items.how: Shellwood's boss, reached by the lift to the central bench.

items.name: Cling Grip
items.how: West of Sister Splinter's arena, past a pogo course: bind the Weaver effigy. Lets you cling to and jump off walls.

items.name: Memory Locket, The Marrow
items.how: Through a narrow opening in the northwest of The Marrow, which you climb to with Cling Grip. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Widow
items.how: Climb with Cling Grip to her arena. Beating her lifts Bellhart's curse.

items.name: Bellhart Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra for 40 Rosaries. She only answers the bronze rings in Bellhart after the Widow is beaten.

items.name: Memory Locket, Bellhart
items.how: Sold by Frey in Bellhart for 330 Rosaries once the Widow is beaten. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Needolin
items.how: Given when Bellhart is freed from its curse.

items.name: Sharpened Needle
items.how: Pinmaster Plinney sharpens the Needle for free once the town is freed.

items.name: Crafting Kit, Creige
items.how: Creige's wish, Crawbug Clearing: hunt Crawbugs in Greymoor and bring back their Ragpelt.

items.name: My Missing Courier
items.how: Frey's wish at the Bellhart Wishwall: follow the goods Tipp dropped, starting in lower Shellwood, to find him. Return to the Bellhart shopkeeper after you talk to him.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Bellhart
items.how: Sold by Frey in Bellhart for 270 Rosaries once the courier quest is done.

items.name: Multibinder
items.how: Sold in Bellhart for 880 Rosaries once the courier quest is done.
items.effect: Bind heals more, up to four Masks.

items.name: Bellhome Key
items.how: Finish the Bellhart donation wishes, then keep talking to Pavo until he has nothing more to say. He gives you the key to the empty bell-house.

items.name: Bellhome Desk
items.how: Furniture for your Bellhome, sold by Frey for 380 Rosaries.

items.name: Bellhome Gleamlights
items.how: Furniture for your Bellhome, sold by Frey for 320 Rosaries.

items.name: Bellhome Bell Lacquer
items.how: Furniture for your Bellhome, sold by Frey for 520 Rosaries.

items.name: Bellhome Personal Spa
items.how: Furniture for your Bellhome, sold by Frey for 1100 Rosaries. It only appears after two other furniture purchases; rest elsewhere and come back if it does not show.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Greymoor
items.how: Near the shortcut to Sinner's Road; climb to it with Cling Grip.

items.name: Pimpillo
items.how: In Yarnaby's tower; climb with Cling Grip. Costs a Craftmetal.
items.effect: A bomb that bursts on contact.

items.name: Mask Shard, Deep Docks
items.how: Above the westernmost bench; climb to it with Cling Grip.

items.name: Wanderer Crest
items.how: In the Chapel of the Wanderer at Bonegrave, west of the Ruined Chapel; you fight a few waves of enemies for it. Cling Grip gets you there down the main funnel in Bone Bottom. Another way in uses a Simple Key through the Wormways.
items.effect: Much faster, narrower slashes, with a small chance of triple-damage hits while Silk is at least one Bind's worth.

items.name: Mask Shard, Wormways
items.how: Behind a breakable wall in the south of the Wormways.

items.name: Wormways Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra.

items.name: Dead Bug's Purse
items.how: Near the northern entrance of the Wormways.
items.effect: Keeps some Rosaries when Hornet dies.

items.name: Memory Locket, Wormways
items.how: In the lower left part of the Wormways. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Barbed Bracelet
items.how: In a pit at the end of the first road.

items.name: Sinner's Road Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra.

items.name: Tacks
items.how: Crull and Benjin's wish, Roach Guts: hunt the Muckroaches of Sinner's Road and bring back their guts.
items.effect: Scatters pins along the ground.

items.name: Great Conchflies
items.how: Two burrowing bosses in the northwest of the Blasted Steps, blocking the way to the Pinstress.

items.name: Blasted Steps Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra.

items.name: Needle Strike
items.how: Talk to the Pinstress in her hut at the far west end and train with her. A charged Needle attack.

items.name: Memory Locket, Blasted Steps
items.how: Pogo across the hanging bells, then drop into a dark passage.

items.name: Silkspeed Anklets
items.how: In Weavenest Cindril, which needs the Needolin.
items.effect: Spends Silk for speed.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Weavenest Atla
items.how: Through the west exit of the lift shaft.

items.name: Mask Shard, Weavenest Atla
items.how: Through the east exit of the lift shaft.

items.name: Moss Mother duo
items.how: Two Moss Mothers at once, west of the Weavenest Atla bench.

items.name: Weavelight
items.how: Past the two Moss Mothers, west of the bench.
items.effect: Silk refills faster.

items.name: Simple Key, Sinner's Road
items.how: Beat the Roachkeeper at the top of the tall room at the east end of the upper Sinner's Road. Any Simple Key opens any locked door; the guide spends this one on the lower Wormways door.

items.name: Plasmium Phial
items.how: Open the lower Wormways door with a Simple Key and climb to Alchemist Zylotol's lab. His wish, Alchemist's Assistant, gives a Needle Phial: draw three Plasmium samples in the Wormways and bring them back.
items.effect: A heal that can take health up to three above the maximum.

items.name: Magnetite Dice
items.how: Lumble the Lucky, left and down from the Blasted Steps Bellway, plays dice for Rosaries. Win until he has no Rosaries left and he pays with his dice. If he dies first (around mid Act 2), take them from his body.
items.effect: A chance to cancel a hit from a foe, not from hazards. The chance grows with each hit taken and resets when it triggers.

items.name: Last Judge
items.how: Ring the five Bellshrines (Marrow, Deep Docks, Greymoor, Bellhart, Shellwood), then play the Needolin at the great door in the northeast of the Blasted Steps. Beating her opens the Grand Gate and starts Act 2.

items.name: Pilgrim's Rest Supplies
items.how: A delivery wish from the couriers Tipp and Pill in Bellhart: carry the Courier's Swag to Mort in Pilgrim's Rest without breaking it (hits, hard landings and fast travel damage or destroy it). Mort pays 180 Rosaries.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Grand Gate
items.how: At the top of a moving mechanism in the hall of scales; climb with Cling Grip.

items.name: Delver's Drill
items.how: On a table in the southwest of the Underworks. It drills through fragile walls.
items.effect: Hornet drills downward into a foe.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Underworks pit
items.how: At the bottom of a pit in the Underworks, near the lift to Trobbio's stage; a four-wave fight opens the door to it.

items.name: White Key
items.how: Lies against the fence on the right side of the Songclave. Ringing the Songclave bell first may make it vanish; then Jubilana sells it for 220 Rosaries after her Wandering Merchant wish. Opens the lift to Whiteward.

items.name: The Wandering Merchant
items.how: Ring the First Shrine bell (80 Rosaries) so the Songclave wish board appears. Take Jubilana's wish, find her in a dark room off the Choral Chambers, clear the enemies and talk to her. She then opens a shop in the Songclave.

items.name: Mask Shard, Songclave
items.how: Sold by Jubilana in the Songclave for 750 Rosaries.

items.name: Ascendant's Grip
items.how: Sold by Jubilana in the Songclave for 350 Rosaries.
items.missableNote: Jubilana's shop opens only after the Wandering Merchant wish, which is an Act 2 wish. Buy it in Act 2; later it may not be possible.

items.name: Spider Strings
items.how: Sold by Jubilana in the Songclave for 320 Rosaries.

items.name: Spool Extender
items.how: Sold by Jubilana in the Songclave for 720 Rosaries.
items.effect: Holds Silk beyond the normal maximum.

items.name: Simple Key, Jubilana
items.how: Sold by Jubilana in the Songclave. Any Simple Key opens any locked door; the guide spends this one on the High Halls door.

items.name: Cogwork Dancers
items.how: Two dancers fought together, reached left of the Songclave bench through a passage above two walls. Beating them opens the Cogwork Core and starts the Threefold Melody.

items.name: Mask Shard, Cogwork Core
items.how: Past the enemy fight in the arena southeast of the central bench; hit the switch on the left and go through.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Cogwork Core
items.how: In the lowest part of the Cogwork Core; time the moving gears to reach it.

items.name: Vaultkeeper's Melody
items.how: At the very bottom of the Whispering Vaults, where the Sacred Cylinder rests; play the Needolin there. One of the three melodies that open The Cradle.

items.name: Mask Shard, Whispering Vaults
items.how: In a side room in the east: break the wall and push the crates into a path. Needs Cling Grip.

items.name: Claw Mirror
items.how: Beat Trobbio on The Stage; flip the lever before the arena for a shortcut to the Grand Bellway bench.

items.name: Shining Needle
items.how: Pinmaster Plinney's wish asks for Pale Oil. One lies in a hidden room of the Choral Chambers, reached through a crate puzzle in the Whispering Vaults; bring it to him.

items.name: Mask Shard, Savage Beastfly
items.how: Savage Beastfly, an Act 2 Grand Hunt on the Bellhart Wishwall: track it by its shed shell to the Far Fields arena where the Fourth Chorus fell, beat it and bring its Horn Fragment back to the Wishwall.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Whiteward
items.how: At the bottom of the main lift shaft: call the lift up and drop down the shaft.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Sherma
items.how: Sherma's wish, Balm for the Wounded, appears on the Songclave board once you have visited Whiteward: follow his trail through Whiteward, break the wall to him and survive the enemy waves.

items.name: Injector Band
items.how: On the east side of Whiteward.
items.effect: A faster Bind.

items.name: Clawline
items.how: Go through Whiteward and drop into the Underworks; light the fan, ride the updraft and bind the Weaver spire in The Cauldron. A grappling hook.

items.name: Garmond and Zaza, duel
items.how: They wait on a platform right of the Songclave, reached through the top right of the Whispering Vaults' main room. Help them with a wave of foes, then talk to Garmond to start a friendly duel. No item; it adds their Journal entry.
items.missableNote: Act 2 only. They may also leave for good if they move into the Songclave.

items.name: Spool Fragment, The Cauldron
items.how: West of The Cauldron; climb with Cling Grip.

items.name: Cogwork Wheel
items.how: Sold by the Twelfth Architect, right of the northeast bench, for 360 Rosaries and a Craftmetal.
items.effect: A thrown circular saw.

items.name: Scuttlebrace
items.how: Sold by the Twelfth Architect for 140 Rosaries and a Craftmetal.

items.name: Sawtooth Circlet
items.how: Sold by the Twelfth Architect for 230 Rosaries and a Craftmetal.
items.effect: Spinning blades circle Hornet when she uses a cloak.

items.name: Crafting Kit, Twelfth Architect
items.how: Sold by the Twelfth Architect for 450 Rosaries.

items.name: Silk Heart, The Unravelled
items.how: Pull the hanging ring high in east Whiteward with the Clawline to drop the Surgeon's Key. Use it on the lock in the operating theatre, drop into the pit, survive two waves and beat The Unravelled; climb the chamber for the Silk Heart.

items.name: Conductor's Melody
items.how: Win the enemy gauntlet in the Forum, then Conductor Ballador teaches the melody. One of the three melodies that open The Cradle.

items.name: Cogfly
items.how: Down a hidden spike path in the High Halls, cleared with the Clawline; build it at the workbench there with a Craftmetal.
items.effect: A winged helper that attacks foes.

items.name: Rosary Cannon
items.how: Open the Simple Key door west of the High Halls bench, cross the platforms, break the wall into the treasury and hit the ceiling to drop the cannon.
items.effect: Fires Rosaries as shots.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Deep Docks southeast
items.how: Behind the southeast gate that the Clawline opens, past lava and spikes.

items.name: Forebrothers Signis & Gron
items.how: Open the locked door under the Forge Daughter's shop with a Simple Key, hang on the Clawline hook to raise the gate, use the lever bridge and head left to a lava arena. Beat both brothers. This opens the way down to the old diving bell. It can wait until Act 3, where it is harder.

items.name: Sharpdart
items.how: In Weavenest Karn, in the west of the Wormways past the lower door: open the stone door with the Needolin, cross with the Clawline and bind the Weaver statue.

items.name: Cross Stitch
items.how: Cross the Mist west of Bilewater (play the Needolin to follow the white moths) to the Exhaust Organ, and beat the Phantom.

items.name: Silkshot
items.how: Take the Ruined Tool from Weavenest Murglin, behind a Needolin door in the southeast of Bilewater. Repair it once, with a Craftmetal: Forge Daughter, Twelfth Architect or the table near Mount Fay's top. Each gives a different Silkshot; the others are then gone.
items.effect: A piercing shot. It comes in three versions and only one is kept per run.

items.name: Quick Sling
items.how: In a secret room above the Mothleaf Lagnia area, behind breakable ceilings.
items.effect: Throws two red Tools at once for two charges. A few Tools do not double.

items.name: Faydown Cloak
items.how: Climb Mount Fay with the Clawline before the cold wins, and call at the peak. Gives a double jump and resistance to the cold.

items.name: Mask Shard, Mount Fay
items.how: Floating near the western bench; reach it with the double jump.

items.name: Memory Crystal
items.how: Behind a wall of ice in a room near the western bench.
items.effect: An ice statue that explodes when Hornet is hit.

items.name: Mask Shard, Skull Cavern
items.how: In the Skull Cavern at the bottom right of Far Fields: survive the enemy waves while the lava rises, then ride the wind to the top niche.

items.name: Mask Shard, Blasted Steps
items.how: A secret jump near the west edge of the Blasted Steps; needs the double jump.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Grindle
items.how: Sold by Grindle in his hideout high in the Blasted Steps, reached with the double jump, for 680 Rosaries.

items.name: Snitch Pick
items.how: Sold by Grindle.
items.effect: Makes the Clawline steal Rosaries and Shell Shards, and hit harder.

items.name: Thief's Mark
items.how: Sold by Grindle for 350 Rosaries.
items.effect: More Rosaries from foes, but some are lost when Hornet is hit.

items.name: Crafting Kit, Grindle
items.how: Sold by Grindle for 700 Rosaries.

items.name: Snare Setter
items.how: In a secret room of Weavenest Atla: double jump into a hidden gap in the ceiling, climb, and take it from the table at the top of the big room.
items.effect: A Silk rune trap that bursts on contact.

items.name: Architect's Melody
items.how: At the top of the Cogwork Core: turn the four great pillars to the right symbols. One of the three melodies that open The Cradle.

items.name: Spool Fragment, High Halls
items.how: High above the Forum: climb the first tower's platforming with the Clawline rings and the double jump.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Memorium
items.how: A thorny climb in the widest shaft on the west side of the Memorium.

items.name: Voltvessels
items.how: Through the vents to the room at the top of the Memorium; clear it and open the locked container.
items.effect: An electric throwing Tool.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Jubilana
items.how: After Balm for the Wounded, Jubilana's second wish, The Lost Merchant: defend her in the Memorium. Back in the Songclave she sells this for 500 Rosaries.

items.name: Key of Apostate
items.how: Break the cage at the far end of a tunnel in the south of the Ducts. Reach it from the Memorium's hidden roof opening, or from Bilehaven after Groal the Great. Opens the last locks in The Slab.

items.name: Wreath of Purity
items.how: On a large floating platform at the end of a hidden room near the Huntress's bench, past a breakable wall.
items.effect: Keeps Muckmaggots off. A bench mends it.

items.name: Rune Rage
items.how: Find the First Sinner's spire through a hidden ceiling path right of the bench near the Bellway, open her locks and beat her.

items.name: Mask Shard, The Slab
items.how: A platforming room in the northeast, behind an Apostate door; the Clawline moves the saws.

items.name: Spool Fragment, The Slab
items.how: At the lookout towards Mount Fay; needs the Key of Apostate and Cling Grip.

items.name: Mask Shard, Wisp Thicket
items.how: A platforming challenge near the east edge of Wisp Thicket.

items.name: Wispfire Lantern
items.how: Beat the Father of the Flame at the west end of Wisp Thicket; hit the braziers, not his body.
items.effect: Spends Silk to send homing wisps at foes.

items.name: Mask Shard, Bilewater
items.how: At the end of a long poison-water passage where fish leap out at you.

items.name: Conchcutter
items.how: Beat the Raging Conchfly at the shrine up the Coral Tower; the tool is in the tower.
items.effect: A piercing shell that bounces off walls.

items.name: Volt Filament
items.how: Climb to the bridge at the top of the Sands, take the hidden path in the top right into the Voltnest, and beat the Voltvyrm.
items.effect: Silk Skills carry an electric charge.

items.name: Simple Key, Sands of Karak
items.how: On a corpse by the bench at the eastern tip of the Sands of Karak. Any Simple Key opens any locked door; the guide spends this one on the Green Prince's cell in Sinner's Road, which leads to Lost Verdania in Act 3.

items.name: Hivesteel Needle
items.how: Loyal Mergwin in the Choral Chambers trades a Pale Oil for five dishes (Great Taste of Pharloom; one needs My Missing Brother, one the Lugoli fight on Sinner's Road, one the Sands of Karak). Bring it and 450 Rosaries to Plinney.

items.name: Longclaw
items.how: The Huntress's wish, Broodfeast: bring organs from foes killed with Flintslate, Longpin and a shredding Tool such as the Cogwork Wheel or Conchcutter. In Act 3 the same wish comes from Runt.
items.effect: Longer Needle reach.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Flea Caravan
items.how: Mooshka's reward once enough lost fleas are rescued for the caravan to move to the Blasted Steps.

items.name: Tool Pouch upgrade, Fleatopia
items.how: Mooshka's reward when enough fleas are rescued for the caravan to settle in Fleatopia.

items.name: Reserve Bind
items.how: The Second Sentinel's wish, Final Audience: rebuild the Cogheart, meet the Sentinel twice, learn the Conductor's Melody and finish two Songclave wishes (Building Up Songclave among them), then win the duel in the High Halls.

items.name: Architect Crest
items.how: Own 25 Tools, then buy the Architect's Key from the Twelfth Architect for 110 Rosaries. Open the chapel above him and bind the crest. The door shuts for good once you leave.
items.effect: The Needle becomes a drill: many quick hits, chargeable for double damage. No white slot, so no Silk Skills.

items.name: Lace, The Cradle
items.how: Play the Threefold Melody in the Cogwork Dancers' room and ride the lift up; Lace waits in the arena at the top. Beating her opens the rest of The Cradle.

items.name: Silk Heart, Lace
items.how: Given for winning the rematch with Lace.

items.name: Throwing Ring
items.how: Buy every one of Shakra's maps (the last ones are in Mount Fay, the Sands of Karak and The Cradle); her wish, Trail's End, then appears in Bellhart. Follow her trail of rings to Bilewater.
items.effect: A thrown ring that bounces.

items.name: Shakra, duel
items.how: After Trail's End, hit the pole holding a ring in Greymoor to call Shakra for a duel. No item; it adds her Journal entry.
items.missableNote: Shakra no longer duels once Act 3 begins.

items.name: Egg of Flealia
items.how: Fleamaster Mooshka's last reward: rescue every lost flea and come back to the Flea Caravan in Fleatopia. It lowers the Silk cost of Silk Skills while your health is full, and it opens the Festival of the Flea in Act 3.

items.name: Tool Pouch upgrade, Nuu
items.how: Nuu's wish, Bugs of Pharloom: record 100 different foes in the Hunter's Journal she gave you, then go back to her at Halfway Home in Greymoor.

items.name: Grand Mother Silk, Bind
items.how: Past Lace, at the top of The Cradle, fight Grand Mother Silk while not cursed and Bind her at the end: the Weaver Queen Ending. The save then reloads at the last Cradle bench, so the other fights stay open.
items.missableNote: Lost once Act 3 begins: the Snared Silk Ending closes this fight for the run.

items.name: Rite of Rebirth
items.how: Take the Twisted Bud from a hidden room in Bilewater, reached through the east end of the Whispering Vaults, and give it to Greyroot in Shellwood after the Pollip wish. You are cursed: no healing, and your Crest, Tools and Skills are taken until it is lifted.

items.name: Grand Mother Silk, cursed
items.how: While still cursed, and before Silk and Soul, beat Grand Mother Silk at the top of The Cradle: the Twisted Child Ending. You cannot heal. The save reloads at the last Cradle bench; then lift the curse for the Witch Crest.
items.missableNote: Lost once Act 3 begins, and once the curse is lifted (Witch Crest).

items.name: Witch Crest
items.how: Infestation Operation: while cursed, visit Yarnaby at the top left of Greymoor, buy Steel Spines (about 260 Rosaries) from Crull and Benjin in the Sinner's Road jail and bring them to her. The curse lifts and the Cursed Crest becomes the Witch Crest.
items.effect: Long whip-like slashes. Its Bind sends out roots that hit nearby enemies and heal a Mask per hit.
items.missableNote: Lifting the curse locks out the Twisted Child ending, so do the cursed Grand Mother Silk fight first. The Crest itself is not lost: the wish can still be done in Act 3.

items.name: Silk and Soul
items.how: Appears on the Bellhart Wishwall, or from the Caretaker in Songclave, once you have 17 wish points; most Act 2 wishes give one. Bring the Caretaker three souls (Maiden's in Bone Bottom, Hermit's below the Bellhart Bellway, Seeker's by the top Bilewater bench) and the Snare Setter.

items.name: Grand Mother Silk, Soul Snare
items.how: With the Soul Snare ready, fight Grand Mother Silk and play the Needolin at the end instead of Binding her. This is the Snared Silk Ending; reloading the save starts Act 3.

items.name: Curvesickle
items.how: An upgrade of the Curveclaw, found in Act 3. In the practice room above the Far Fields Bellway, hit every target with one Curveclaw throw (the Pollip Pouch does not work). A Skarr scout takes it; rest at a bench and the Curvesickle is left behind.

items.name: Diving Bell Key
items.how: In Act 3 the Caretaker's family at the Ruined Chapel sends you to the Deep Docks. Ballow moves above the old diving bell at the very bottom and hands you its key.

items.name: Silk Soar
items.how: On the first trip down, go east past a Needolin door into Weavenest Absolom and touch the structure on the lower platform. A charged leap straight up; you need it to leave the Abyss.

items.name: Claw Mirrors
items.how: An upgrade of the Claw Mirror. In Act 3 the Songclave wish Pain, Anguish and Misery sends you to beat Tormented Trobbio on the Stage; the Dark Mirror then joins your Claw Mirror. Needs the Claw Mirror and Silk Soar.

items.name: Elegy of the Deep
items.how: Spell Seeker: back from the Abyss, talk to the Snail Shamans in the Ruined Chapel beside Bone Bottom. They teach a Needolin song that opens old memories, and send you after the Old Hearts.

items.name: Grey Memento
items.how: Use Silk Soar to reach a dormant statue, the Watcher at the Edge, at the far west edge of the Sands of Karak. Play the Needolin to wake it and beat it. Reports differ on this spot.

items.name: Shaman Crest
items.how: In the Snail Shamans' chapel, go to the dead end on the east side, Silk Soar up through the gap above and Bind the big snail shell.
items.effect: Built around Silk Skills: they hit harder and attacks become short-range energy waves. Its Bind starts with a ground slam, so it does not heal in mid-air.

items.name: Crust King Khann
items.how: At the far end of the Sands of Karak, past a tall shaft, play the Elegy by the old king's body to enter the Coral Tower memory. Beat him at the top for the Encrusted Heart.

items.name: Nyleth
items.how: Silk Soar through the top of the Grand Gate lift shaft and find the hidden way down to the Shellwood Shrine. Beat its guardian, Seth, then play the Elegy at Nyleth's monument and win her memory fight for the Pollen Heart.

items.name: Skarrsinger Karmelita
items.how: Enter Hunter's March from The Marrow (the Deep Docks side is blocked in Act 3), clear the new gauntlet and Silk Soar in the statue room into a hidden part of Far Fields. Play the Elegy by the queen and win for the Hunter's Heart.

items.name: Conjoined Heart
items.how: Free the Green Prince from his Sinner's Road cell with a Simple Key and meet him twice in the Citadel. In Act 3 play the Elegy of the Deep at the right wall of Craw Lake, clear 12 orbs in a row in Lost Verdania and beat the Clover Dancers. Their heart can stand in for one Old Heart.

items.name: Everbloom
items.how: Bring the three Old Hearts to the Snail Shamans. Their ritual sends you into the Red Memory; clear it to claim the Everbloom, which lets you go deeper into the Abyss. The Clover Dancers' heart can stand in for one Old Heart.

items.name: Hero's Memento
items.how: The Hero's Call wish on the Bellhart Wishwall: find and beat Lost Garmond in the Blasted Steps, then talk to him. The wish may not appear until late in the game, so the route waits for the Everbloom.

items.name: Mask Shard, Sprintmaster Swift
items.how: Fastest in Pharloom, an Act 3 wish from Sprintmaster Swift or the Bellhart Wishwall: beat him in three races of three laps each. The last race gives the Mask Shard.

items.name: Mask Shard, The Hidden Hunter
items.how: The Hidden Hunter, an Act 3 wish: follow bone piles across Far Fields until a trap drags you to Gurr the Outcast's lair. Beat him and bring the Grass Doll to the Bellhart Wishwall.

items.name: Mask Shard, Dark Hearts
items.how: Dark Hearts, an Act 3 wish on the Bellhart Wishwall: destroy Void Masses around Pharloom, then come back to Bellhart.

items.name: Mask Shard, Brightvein
items.how: From the southeast bench of Mount Fay go south and west; Silk Soar off a rock floating in icy water, west of the big chasm, into Brightvein. Climb to the top, bouncing off the Mnemonords.

items.name: Pale Nails
items.how: In Act 3 the lift to The Cradle no longer works: from the upper right hall of the Choral Chambers, Silk Soar up through the ruined Cogwork Core into The Cradle. Climb to Grand Mother Silk's old arena and bind her severed arm.

items.name: Pin Badge
items.how: Fatal Resolve, an Act 3 wish (a note in the Pinstress's hut, or the Bellhart Wishwall once you have Silk Soar): find the Pinstress asleep at the peak of Mount Fay, wake her and win the duel.
items.effect: Needle Strike charges faster.

items.name: Pale Steel Needle
items.how: Needs the last Pale Oil: beat the fleas' best scores in all three Festival of the Flea games (Mooshka's Act 3 wish, Putrified Ducts). Free Plinney from a gauntlet in a Shellwood graveyard; back in Bellhart he forges it for Rosaries.

items.name: Sylphsong
items.how: Once your Crests other than Hunter have 32 slots open between them (Memory Lockets), Eva asks to be Bound. Do it to learn Sylphsong: Silk refills while you rest at a bench.

items.name: Passing of the Age
items.how: A riddle tablet in a hidden cave at the top right of Pale Lake starts it. Find Mister Mushroom in seven places, in order: Moss Grotto, Bone Bottom, Far Fields, Greymoor, The Slab, Mount Fay, The Cradle.

items.name: Lost Lace
items.how: With the Everbloom, Ballow mends the diving bell for one last dive. Cut Pharloom free of the Void, then beat Lost Lace in the Abyss: the Sister of the Void Ending.
